About Shomoukh Early Childhood Education

In the Sultanate of Oman, education is a fundamental right and every child possesses boundless potential.

OUR FOUNDATION

Welcome to Shomoukh Nursery Schools

Inspired by the world-renowned Reggio Emilia approach from Italy, blending international excellence with authentic Omani values.

Shomoukh Early Childhood Education is an International Early Years Nursery School. In our school, children are viewed as unique, capable, resilient, creative, curious, and intelligent individuals. We embrace everyone's culture while offering children a wide range of opportunities to become confident and prepare them to meet future challenges.

Our students are active citizens who reach their full potential within a safe, healthy, nurturing, and aesthetic environment that respects their rights and opinions. Teaching methods are based on children's needs and interests, ensuring that every child is actively involved in the learning process and receives personal attention and guidance.

Book a Visit Now
Reggio Emilia Philosophy

The child is recognized as having 100 languages for thinking, expressing, and learning.

OUR PHILOSOPHY

Nurturing Mind, Body, and Spirit

Our school's ethos and culture promote positive relations among all members and provide opportunities so that each child feels fulfilled.

Collaborative Partnerships

We believe that genuine partnerships between the school, parents, and the wider community play an important and indispensable role in the child's educational journey. Families are warmly invited to participate in school-related activities, initiate collaborative projects, and lend their active support during annual events.

We strive to create a happy, stimulating environment that emphasizes the social, emotional, physical, and cognitive development of each child, preparing them for lifelong confidence.

Our Mission

To provide high-quality childcare services and promote the development of creativity and self-confidence of children in a positive, friendly, and respectful learning environment to prepare them for a lifelong learning experience.

Our Vision

To create a joyful, warm, and fun educational sanctuary that emphasizes the holistic social, emotional, physical, and mental development of each child, empowering them to become leaders of tomorrow.

Our Values

We value excellence in caring, high spirits of optimism, collegiality, and community involvement. Continuous professional development is recognized as both a right and duty for every educator guiding our children.

OUR PILLARS OF INTEGRITY

Core Principles

The foundational values that guide our daily interactions, programs, and community initiatives.

Community

At Shomoukh, we believe in diversity while deeply respecting Omani cultural heritage and values. We organize regular events and activities throughout the academic year to foster a deep sense of belonging and mutual respect.

Giving Back

Our school maintains close, meaningful ties with the local community in Muscat and organizes charitable events and donation drives during the academic year to actively support those in need.

Environmental Care

We continuously promote environmental sustainability and eco-consciousness, teaching children the values of Reducing, Reusing, and Recycling through our hands-on organic garden activities.

Health & Safety

Your child's physical health, emotional well-being, and security are our highest priorities. Our safety protocols and hygiene standards are the highest in the early childhood industry, meeting and exceeding all Ministry guidelines.
